chunks: And Zurārah narrated from him that he said to him:
A man sees a scorpion, a viper, and a snake while he is praying—should he kill it? He said: "Yes, if he wishes, he may do so."

key_terms.إِنْ شَاءَ: if he wishes, showing the act is optional
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the narrator transmitting the report

ai.seo_question: Can someone kill a scorpion or snake while performing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who encounters harmful creatures during salat (prayer). It indicates that killing such a creature during prayer is permitted if the person chooses to do so.
